requirements.text: A simple calendar for study room bookings that allows students to select a date, time, and room size easily.
A feature for managing loans that displays all borrowed books, due dates, and allows online renewals.
Reminders for due dates through both phone notifications and emails to help students keep track of their returns.
Automatic notifications for any fines related to late returns, along with a clear list of outstanding fines when checking loans.
The system should be user-friendly and beneficial for students without adding complexity.
